title: Web need: sidecar status and export for Library samples
description:
## Need (for the web/docs session; not visuals)
In the Library, a person should be able to tell whether a sample has a sidecar and get one without the terminal:
- per sample: sidecar present / missing / edited in the DAW (not imported yet);
- an action that runs the same export for the selected sample(s) and shows the report lines.

## Data the UI needs
An endpoint on `apricity serve` (or a GraphQL custom operation, coordinated with the storage initiative apricitus-e70662) returning, per sample, `{sidecar: "none"|"current"|"edited", path}` and running an export with the same outcomes as the CLI.

## Out of scope
Design, layout and wording of the controls (the web session decides).

## Verify
The web session files its own UI tasks from this; this task is done when the endpoint exists and `node web/test/...` (named by the web session) calls it.
